questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT among the four ingredients or components of the Preamble to the Constitution of India?
questions.a: A list of the Fundamental Duties of the citizens
o: A list of the Fundamental Duties of the citizens
Source of authority of the Constitution
Date of adoption of the Constitution
questions.e: The Preamble has four components: the source of authority (We, the people of India), the nature of the State (sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic, republic), the objectives (justice, liberty, equality, fraternity) and the date of adoption (26 November 1949). Duties are not among them.
w: This is the ingredient 'source of authority' (the people of India); it is present.
This is an ingredient: sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic republic.
This is an ingredient: 26 November 1949.

questions.q: Which one of the following words was NOT part of the Preamble when the Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949?

w: Sovereign is in the original Preamble; only three words were added in 1976.
Democratic is in the original Preamble.
Republic is in the original Preamble.

questions.q: In the four-fold analysis of the Preamble, the words 'justice, liberty, equality and fraternity' stand for

the source of authority of the Constitution
the date of adoption of the Constitution

w: The nature of the State is 'sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic and republican'.
